SUMMARY.md: AntiBrow's public dataset of browser-fingerprinting and anti-bot detection runs (CC BY 4.0, no key, CORS open). Knowledge comes from the field documentation at https://antibrow.com/reports/data and from live GET probes on 2026-10-23, when two runs were published (`detection-2026-08`, `detection-2026-09`). `/reports/{slug}` was found by probing (the docs name only `/api/v1/reports`); it returns the same object as the static file `https://antibrow.com/reports/{slug}/data.json`, and `/reports` returns the same body as `https://antibrow.com/reports/all.json`. Unknown slugs return 404 with `{"error":{"code":"NOT_FOUND","message":"Unknown run"}}`. Not modelled: the CSV downloads. Unverified: the full set of `metrics` keys, which vary by detector.
Browser build the run was headlined on, for example `Chrome 153`.
ISO 8601 (date-only where only a date was recorded).
Machine the run was driven from, for example `macOS, headful`.
Subject id that checks refer to, for example `antibrow`.
